city.name: Cincinnati
city.regionLabel: Cincinnati, Northern Kentucky and a sensible drive

events.title: Jack O’Lantern Glow
events.time: Timed trail entry 6:00 PM–9:45 PM; event closes 10:00 PM
events.description: Follow a half-mile trail of more than 6,000 carved pumpkins. This evening experience needs a separate ticket; zoo admission and membership alone do not include it.

events.title: Mrs. Mannerly: opening-week performances
events.description: Dale Hodges and Raymond McAnally return in Jeffrey Hatcher’s comedy about a boy and his formidable etiquette teacher in 1967 Ohio. The performance lasts 90 minutes without intermission.

events.title: Panda Fest: Asian food and culture
events.priceLabel: General admission $14; food extra; gate $20 + tax
events.description: Browse Asian street-food vendors, craft stalls and cultural performances beside the river. Admission is for a selected entry slot; food purchases are separate and tickets are nonrefundable.

events.title: Brantley Gilbert: Real American Tour
events.description: Brantley Gilbert brings his country-rock tour to the pavilion with John Morgan and Atlus. Parking is included in the ticket price; check the venue’s clear-bag rules.

events.title: Catch Your Breath: Not Broken Enough Tour
events.time: 6:00 PM listed ticket time; Check source for door/show details
events.description: Catch Your Breath brings its Not Broken Enough tour to Short Vine. The official ticket page lists 6 PM; confirm the final door and performance schedule before heading out.

events.title: Charm at the Farm: October vintage market
events.description: Shop vintage furniture, repurposed décor, clothing and handmade finds at the farm’s final market weekend. Friday VIP and Saturday Early Bird tickets must be bought online; parking is free.

events.title: Euge Groove
events.description: An intimate Friday jazz show at the historic Ludlow Garage. The venue lists all-ages admission and a range of reserved ticket prices; check remaining seats before making plans.

events.title: Haunted Village at Heritage Village Museum
events.priceLabel: $15; members and ages 2 and under free
events.description: Trick-or-treat through the historic village, with costumed characters, games and a haunted house. The 2026 additions include an adventure trail and carnival-themed scares; tickets are sold at the gate.

events.title: Hiss Golden Messenger with Sam Amidon
events.description: M.C. Taylor’s Americana project pairs with Sam Amidon for a standing-room Sanctuary show. A strong smaller-room choice for listeners drawn to folk, soul and thoughtful songwriting.

events.title: Jess Hilarious
events.address: 7518 Bales Street, Space A-120, Liberty Township, OH 45069
events.description: Choose an early or late stand-up set with Jess Hilarious at Liberty Center. Check your selected performance carefully because Friday and Saturday have different start times.

events.title: Magical Forest Halloween Hike with characters
events.time: Timed hikes from 6:00 PM; Check source for remaining slots
events.address: 430 West North Bend Road, Cincinnati, OH 45216
events.age: Best suited for ages 3–10 with family
events.description: Meet nature and history characters along a pumpkin-lit trail on this non-scary guided walk. Register for a timed departure; uneven footing and stairs make the route unsuitable for strollers.

events.title: Mark Chalifoux at Go Bananas
events.description: Catch the Cincinnati comic’s laid-back stand-up in one of two nightly sets. Seating is first come, first served, and the club rates the material R.

events.title: The Sixties Show
events.description: A live-band recreation of 1960s hits, deep cuts and period atmosphere with archival visuals and vintage instruments. The production runs about two hours and ten minutes including intermission.

events.title: Jack-O-Lantern Hike at Caldwell
events.address: 430 West North Bend Road, Cincinnati, OH 45216
events.description: Take a quieter evening walk among carved pumpkins and trail lights. Advance timed registration is required; Saturday has no costumed characters, and the uneven route is not stroller-friendly.

events.title: Made in Camp: Camp Washington State Fair
events.description: Discover Camp Washington makers, demonstrations and live music at Valley Park. The published schedule includes a coney-eating contest and a 3:30 PM Oddball Parade with the neighborhood marching band.

events.title: Mt. Adams Fall Art Festival
events.address: Throughout the Mt. Adams business district, Cincinnati, OH 45202
events.description: Walk between local artist booths, galleries and neighborhood businesses, with live music and a Little Artist Zone. The festival spreads through the hill rather than using one enclosed site.
events.sourceName: Mt. Adams Today / Mt. Adams Business Guild

events.title: AFI
events.description: AFI takes over Bogart’s for a Saturday rock show. The ticket page distinguishes the 7 PM doors from the 8 PM performance, so plan arrival accordingly.

events.title: Bobby Bare Jr. with Hello June
events.description: Guided by Voices’ Bobby Bare Jr. shares the Sanctuary bill with Hello June, whose songs move between intimate indie writing and fuller alternative-rock arrangements.

events.title: Burnet Woods Fall Fest
events.description: Join a free pumpkin-carving and decorating party near the lake, with music, educational displays and the nature center open. Pumpkins are first come, first served, so arrive early.
events.sourceName: Cincinnati Parks / Burnet Woods Park Advisory Council

events.title: Charm at the Farm: October vintage market
events.time: Early Bird 9:00 AM–11:30 AM; general admission noon–4:00 PM
events.priceLabel: General admission $10; Early Bird $15; ages 12 and under free
events.description: Shop vintage furniture, repurposed décor, clothing and handmade finds at the farm’s final market weekend. Friday VIP and Saturday Early Bird tickets must be bought online; parking is free.

events.title: Cincinnati Bearcats basketball vs. Illinois: exhibition
events.address: Fifth Third Arena, University of Cincinnati campus, Cincinnati, OH
events.description: Get an early look at the Bearcats against Illinois in this preseason exhibition. This game requires a separate ticket even for Cincinnati season-ticket holders; confirm seat and parking availability.

events.title: Cincinnati Roller Derby vs. Southern Indiana
events.description: The Halloween-themed bout includes costume prizes, DJ Boywife and halftime dancing. Bring new socks for the Bethany House collection if you’d like to support the evening’s charity partner.

events.title: Cincinnati Symphony: Songs of Destiny
events.description: Cristian Măcelaru conducts Howell, Khachaturian and Brahms, with violinist Alexandra Conunova and the May Festival Chorus. Choose Saturday evening or the Sunday matinee in Music Hall.
events.sourceName: Cincinnati Arts Association / Cincinnati Symphony Orchestra

events.title: Edie McKee Harper: Modernist at Play opens
events.venue: Taft Museum of Art, Fifth Third Gallery
events.priceLabel: Adults $15; seniors $12; youth 17 and under free
events.description: See the opening day of a museum exhibition devoted to Edie Harper’s own artistic range, from photographs and paintings to textiles and prints, with more than 100 works.

events.title: Fall on the Farm at Blooms & Berries
events.description: Explore the five-acre mystery-themed corn maze, hayrides, petting farm and play areas. The final hayride leaves 30 minutes before closing; allow time for more than one activity.

events.title: HallZOOween
events.priceLabel: Included with zoo admission or membership; Check source for admission price
events.description: Make a daytime Halloween visit for trick-or-treat fun and pumpkin enrichment. Bring a treat bag and check the zoo’s daily activity schedule before picking your route.

events.address: Sawyer Point outdoor skating rink, Cincinnati, OH
events.priceLabel: Free; check source for equipment arrangements
events.description: Close out the outdoor skating season with the organizer’s Halloween finale at Sawyer Point. Bring your skates and check current rink updates and equipment arrangements before leaving.

events.title: The City Flea at Washington Park
events.description: Browse the final regular fall City Flea at Washington Park, with independent makers and vintage sellers. Pair the market with a neighborhood lunch; purchases and food are extra.

events.description: Cincinnati hosts Columbus in the Ohio rivalry at TQL Stadium. Kickoff has moved to 5 PM, so disregard older schedules showing 7 PM and leave time for matchday crowds.

events.title: Family Funday: Edie Harper at the Taft
events.description: Celebrate the new Edie Harper exhibition with artmaking, gallery time, Humane Society dog ambassadors and an afternoon Peanut Butter & Jam music session. Drop in without registering.
